before.requirement: Reach the array printer’s depth-limit rejection for a constructed array tree.
before.reason: The complete old array printer has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the array printer’s externally visible failure for a constructed array at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
after.reason: The new guard fails at depth 1000 under the supplied build and header default. The harness has no construction route, and both container parsers reject a node at that depth before printing.

source_evidence.quote:
#define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT 1000
#endif

claims.reason: g0001 adds an observable print failure for constructed deep arrays. The fixed harness cannot provide such an array to any printer.

before.requirement: Reach the object printer’s depth-limit rejection for a constructed object tree.
before.reason: The complete old object printer has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the object printer’s externally visible failure for a constructed object at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
after.reason: The new guard fails at the default limit. Parsing rejects array and object nodes at that same depth, and the harness never constructs a deeper object tree.

source_evidence.quote:
#define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT 1000
#endif

claims.reason: g0002 adds an observable print failure for constructed deep objects. The same old harness cannot supply one.

before.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
before.reason: The array printer delegates children to a value printer with a Raw case. Parsed array children come from parse_value, whose complete dispatch has no Raw case.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
after.reason: The new guard permits a shallow constructed array, but the fixed harness still passes only parsed trees to its printers.

claims.reason: On both sides, the same parse-only tree setup prevents a Raw array child from reaching printing. A finite supported setup is an array containing cJSON_CreateRaw("1 "); parsing `[1 ]` instead creates a Number child.

before.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a cJSON_Raw member.
before.reason: The object printer delegates each member to the Raw-capable value printer, while object parsing delegates member values to parse_value, which cannot create Raw.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a cJSON_Raw member.
after.reason: The shallow Raw member remains supported after the depth guard, but the fixed harness has no construction or insertion step.

claims.reason: Both versions support printing a constructed Raw object member. The same harness constraint blocks it: parsing `{"x":1e0}` creates a Number, while adding a Raw member holding `1e0` would preserve that spelling.

before.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.
after.reason: The new guard rejects an array only at a depth the parser already rejects.

claims.reason: The fixed harness prints parser-produced arrays on both sides; its accepted-depth behavior remains reachable.

before.requirement: Print a parser-produced object at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.
before.reason: The old object printer has no depth rejection.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced object at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.
after.reason: The new object guard rejects only a container depth that parsing already rejects.

claims.reason: The fixed harness prints parser-produced objects on both sides; its accepted-depth behavior remains reachable.
